## Download

Download **PotatoLLM-Setup.exe** below, run it and click through. No admin rights are needed. The first time PotatoLLM opens, it downloads the right AI model for your computer (about 1–3 GB); after that it works without the internet.

**Windows may say "Windows protected your PC"**, because the installer isn't code-signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Works on Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit), and is designed for modest laptops such as the Lenovo ThinkPad X250. Laptops with 8 GB of memory or more get Gemma 3 4B; 4 GB laptops get Gemma 3 1B.

The `xpdf-…-source.tar.gz` file is the source code of the bundled PDF reader, provided under its GPL licence. Most people don't need it.
